name: The Black Shield
summary: Krog sends you to Brackenwall Village to ask Do'gol about the Blackened Iron Shield.

sections.title: A Second Opinion
sections.body: Krog finds nothing unusual about the Blackened Iron Shield. Still, he thinks Do'gol, the blacksmith in Brackenwall Village, may see something more. He urges you not to expect much.

sections.title: Do'gol's Answer
sections.body: Do'gol calls the shield good, strong, and heavy. But he makes shields rather than buying them, so he has no need for it. He says you should know that.

faq.q: Who sends you to Do'gol with the shield?
aliases: who gives the black shield quest
where do i start the black shield
faq.answer: Krog sends you to Do'gol after finding nothing unusual about the Blackened Iron Shield.
Do'gol is the blacksmith in Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: Why does Krog send you to Do'gol?
aliases: why show the shield to the blacksmith
faq.answer: Krog hopes Do'gol can tell him more about the shield, though he expects little from the inspection.

attribution: Classic quest text: The Black Shield
